notes: «ما أخبرني أحد ... إلا أم هانئ فإنها حدثت» names Umm Hani as the one who transmits the report, so she is the last link.

«أبو موسى، محمد بن المثنى» is read as two co-transmitters, as the text's «حدثنا ... حدثنا» form gives; nothing in the text merges them. Tirmidhi's closing remarks on نعيم and the second chain for it are not the same saying, so they are left out.
